head: working-tree

scope.skip_rationale: Standard 3 (source venv) and Standard 4 (integer step numbering) are not applicable to render-template/data-file diffs per task brief.

diff_methodology: git diff 9218b6bd -- <file> applied per AC-2.6 verdict-plumbing rules. Findings are scoped to lines introduced or modified by this cycle's diff. For react_template.tpl, all considered findings were checked against pre-diff baseline (commit 9218b6bd) via the diff hunks — file:line locations refer to working-tree line numbers in scripts/lib/react_template.tpl (HEAD).

advisory_observations.finding: accommodation-1-2 embeds a base64-encoded inline SVG in both cover_image and image fields (a synthetic seed asset, not pipeline-fetched content).
advisory_observations.rationale_not_a_violation: Standard 2 targets scripts, not data files. The task brief explicitly identifies this as the R1c seed for AC9 cover-replacement testing — intentional product data. Production trip data files routinely embed content. Codex's PROPOSED_FIX (replace with real fetched image) is a data-pipeline-quality concern, not a /dev quality-standard violation.

advisory_observations.finding: Coupled JS/CSS timing constants — JS setTimeout(400/600), throttle 500ms — must stay aligned with CSS animation durations 0.4s/0.6s.
advisory_observations.rationale_not_a_violation: Standard 2 exempts 'constants that genuinely never change' (display constants). UI animation durations are display constants, not environment-specific configuration. Refactoring to named constants with CSS interpolation is a refinement, not a /dev standard violation.

advisory_observations.finding: Process-provenance tokens like 'codex F6', 'codex F9' embedded alongside functional rationale.
advisory_observations.rationale_not_a_violation: Comments are short (1-3 lines) and explain edge-case rationale. Spec markers (R1c v3, RC-12, S2 v3) are tied to functional behavior, not marketing. Std 8 verbose-comment threshold not crossed. Optional cleanup only.

advisory_observations.finding: Inline <style>{...}</style> block of ~25 lines with !important rules and @keyframes.
advisory_observations.rationale_not_a_violation: Runtime CSS, not documentation. Std 8 governs explanatory prose, not functional render output. The two-line comment preceding the block explains why !important is required (override inline background:'transparent' on .slot-drop overlays) — functional rationale, not marketing.

advisory_observations.finding: Dense one-line onDragOver/onDrop JSX handlers (long expression chains on a single physical line).
advisory_observations.rationale_not_a_violation: Inline event handlers are JSX best-practice debate territory, not a /dev standard. Std 8 targets explanatory prose, not executable JSX. Refactoring to extracted helpers is an optional readability improvement.

standards_passed: no-inline-code (Std 1) — N/A: render template, not command/agent .md
no-hardcoded-values (Std 2) — only display/animation constants present; codex Q2/Q5 logged as observations (see above)

meaningful-naming (Std 5) — new helpers (findSelectedOption, _synthesizeCardFromV2Option, _matchesOption, _flashSuccess, _flashReject) are descriptive; 'V2' refers to schema version (pre-existing adaptV2Option convention)
english-only (Std 6) — no Chinese in code or comments; Chinese in day-01.json is intentional product UI string, exempt per task brief
merge-similar-scripts (Std 7) — N/A: single file diff, no script duplication introduced
concise-documentation (Std 8) — comments are functional edge-case rationale, no marketing/verbose prose; codex Q1/Q3/Q4 logged as observations
parameterized-scripts (Std 9) — render template consumed by wrapping script; no environment-specific values requiring CLI extraction introduced

dangling-references (Std 10) — all new helpers (findSelectedOption, findSelectedAccommodationOption, _synthesizeCardFromV2Option, _matchesOption, _flashSuccess, _flashReject) defined in same file; mergeEditorSelectionsIntoPublishedDay call-site at line 2597 updated to 4-arg signature matching new definition at line 2045
merge-conflicts (Std 11) — grep for <<<<<<<|=======|>>>>>>> returned no matches in either file

codex_consult.feedback_summary: Codex returned 5 findings: Q1/Q3/Q4 OBSERVATION_ONLY (codex agrees no violation); Q2 PROPOSED_FIX flagging base64 SVG placeholder as production data quality concern; Q5 PROPOSED_FIX flagging coupled JS/CSS timing constants. Codex confirmed Std 5 'V2' is schema-version terminology, not a generic enhancement suffix.

findings.issue: Q1 — inline <style>{...}</style> block (~25 lines) at react_template.tpl:2913-2940
findings.rationale: Codex agrees: runtime CSS is not Std 8 documentation territory.

findings.issue: Q2 — base64 SVG inline placeholder in day-01.json:207-208 cover_image/image fields
findings.proposed_fix: Remove both inline data URIs and either populate proper image cache/asset path with real fetched/committed image, or make AC9 verify cover replacement without seeding a fake base64 image.
findings.rationale: Std 2 (no-hardcoded-values) targets scripts, not data files. Task brief explicitly identifies this as the R1c seed for AC9 cover-replacement testing — intentional product data. Codex's concern is data-pipeline quality, which is a separate scope from /dev quality standards. Surfacing to user as observation; not auto-fixing.

findings.issue: Q3 — dense one-line onDragOver/onDrop JSX handlers
findings.rationale: Codex agrees: not a defined /dev conciseness violation; readability refactor is optional.

findings.issue: Q4 — spec-marker comments (R1c, RC-12, S2 v3, codex F6)
findings.rationale: Codex agrees: comments are short and functional; optional cleanup of process-provenance tokens only.

findings.issue: Q5 — coupled JS/CSS timing constants (setTimeout 400/600, throttle 500, CSS 0.4s/0.6s)
findings.proposed_fix: Extract named constants and interpolate CSS durations from them for strict no-hardcoded-values.
findings.rationale: Std 2 exempts 'display constants that genuinely never change' — UI animation durations qualify. Coupling between JS timeout and CSS keyframe is a refactoring opportunity, not a /dev standard violation.

codex_consult.feedback_incorporated: Codex's Q1/Q3/Q4 confirmed draft verdict. Q2 and Q5 PROPOSED_FIX classified as out_of_scope and observation_only respectively per Rule 3 (caller filters codex output, codex does not set verdict). All 5 findings are surfaced in advisory_observations[] with rationale_not_a_violation. Final verdict unchanged: zero /dev standard violations.

verdict: PASS — zero /dev standard violations in cycle diff scope for files scripts/lib/react_template.tpl and data/beijing-lijiang-dali-20260418-100846/days/day-01.json. 5 advisory observations logged (3 of which codex itself flagged OBSERVATION_ONLY; 2 PROPOSED_FIX entries classified as out-of-scope/observation per caller's filtering rule).
